findings.evidenceJa: ライダーをやり過ごせない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he cannot get past, evade, or weather Rider without Archer’s arm.
findings.explanation: The English changes the immediate escape problem into a general comparison of combat ability.

findings.highlight: I can’t afford to use any more projection
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上の投影は限度を超える
findings.governingReading: Any further Projection exceeds Shirou’s bodily limit.
findings.explanation: The English turns an already breached hard limit into a vague question of what he can afford.

findings.governingReading: Facing death, Shirou accepts an all-or-nothing gamble.
findings.explanation: The English presents risk-taking as merely preferable and weakens the binary desperation.

findings.highlight: not daring to take my eyes off her
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーを見据えたまま
findings.governingReading: Shirou keeps Rider fixed in his gaze while starting his circuits.
findings.explanation: The English adds that he does not dare look away, supplying fear or constraint absent from the source.

findings.highlight: I won’t make any weapons until the last second
findings.evidenceJa: 投影はギリギリまで出さない
findings.governingReading: Shirou will not bring out the Projection until the absolute limit.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the product and shifts focus from withholding the technique to delaying weapon manufacture.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーが俺に踏み込んできた瞬間
findings.governingReading: Shirou plans to respond at the instant Rider steps into his space.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes a precise distance-closing trigger into any attack.

findings.highlight: I’ll project something and counter her
findings.evidenceJa: ゼロ秒で剣を作り上げ全力で迎撃する
findings.governingReading: He will complete a sword in zero seconds and meet her with full force.
findings.explanation: The English removes the zero-time constraint, replaces the sword with “something,” and drops the full-force counter.

findings.governingReading: Rider names the technique as Projection magecraft.
findings.explanation: The English drops the system category and leaves only the technique name.

findings.highlight: I cannot use you to your full potential
findings.evidenceJa: 私では貴方を使いこなせません
findings.governingReading: Rider says she herself cannot master or properly wield Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English implies she can use him partially, weakening the categorical incompatibility behind her withdrawal.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの殺気が薄れていく
findings.explanation: The English again reduces immediate lethal intent to general hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: あっさりと引き下がった
findings.governingReading: Rider readily withdraws after reading Shirou’s plan.
findings.explanation: The English makes a local backward step and adds relaxation instead of her uncomplicated withdrawal from the confrontation.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが健在であったのなら
findings.governingReading: Rider says Saber would have been Shirou’s partner had she remained alive, intact, or in fighting condition.
findings.explanation: The English reduces Saber’s lost viable condition to simple absence from the scene.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの気配が遠ざかっていく
findings.governingReading: Rider’s presence grows more distant as she departs.
findings.explanation: The repeated English line again erases the gradual, directional departure.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り返らずに屋敷から出た
findings.governingReading: Rider leaves the property without looking back.
findings.explanation: The English preserves departure but removes the gesture of deliberate finality.

findings.evidenceJa: それが俺の思い違いでなければ
findings.governingReading: Shirou again allows that his reading of Rider’s mercy may be mistaken.
findings.explanation: The repeated English line turns self-doubt into a potentially correct suspicion.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Rider may lend him her strength.
findings.explanation: The repeated English line expands the beneficiary to his whole group.
